# laravel_forge_regions (Data Source)

Data source for listing Forge regions for a specific cloud provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# First get the provider ID
data "laravel_forge_providers" "digitalocean" {
  filter {
    name   = "slug"
    values = ["ocean2"]
  }
}

# Retrieve all regions for DigitalOcean
data "laravel_forge_regions" "do_regions" {
  provider_id = data.laravel_forge_providers.digitalocean.providers[0].id
}

# Filter by code
data "laravel_forge_regions" "nyc" {
  provider_id = data.laravel_forge_providers.digitalocean.providers[0].id
  filter {
    name   = "code"
    values = ["nyc1", "nyc3"]
  }
}

# Filter by name
data "laravel_forge_regions" "amsterdam" {
  provider_id = data.laravel_forge_providers.digitalocean.providers[0].id
  filter {
    name   = "name"
    values = ["Amsterdam"]
  }
}

# Output
output "all_regions" {
  value = data.laravel_forge_regions.do_regions.regions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud provider to get regions for

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) Filter block for selecting specific regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) List of regions available for the specified provider (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by (e.g., 'name', 'code')
- `values` (List of String) The list of values to match for the specified field


<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `alternate_code` (String) The alternate region code
- `code` (String) The region code
- `id` (Number) The region ID
- `name` (String) The region name
